name: opentunes
description: Chrome-only web app that puts music, video and podcasts on an iPod (tested on the nano 7th generation only), with no backend.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w core && npm run typecheck -w app && tsc -p engine/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w core && npm run test -w app
scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:devices && git diff --exit-code docs/DEVICE-SUPPORT.md
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
